readme: Recipe database for Thrifty Crew meal prep. Every recipe published to the Meal Prep section is logged here. 'ingredients' lists each component by its exact food-macros-db.json item name plus grams (used to recompute macros via recipe-macros.ps1) and a 'buy' note (how much to purchase). EVERY ingredient item MUST exist in food-macros-db.json first. 'grocery_list' is the human shopping list. 'per_serving' and 'batch' macros are computed from the food DB. Costs are conservative current Walmart/Sam's estimates (labels-accurate macros, price-estimate costs; see meal-prep-macros-db memory). To add a recipe: ensure all ingredients are in food-macros-db.json, compute with recipe-macros.ps1, append a record here, then publish with publish-recipe.ps1.
